author: Roosevelt
description:
To celebrate the 10th anniversary of my debut album, I’m releasing a special anniversary vinyl edition on August 21st.

Limited to 1000 copies worldwide and including 7 previously unreleased bonus tracks. One of them, 'Soleil' - originally a B-side to one of my earliest singles - is available on all streaming platforms today.

The anniversary edition is a double LP pressed on white vinyl and includes a signed postcard. Pre-orders are now open via the link in my bio.

Thank you for the continuous support over the last decade, it means the world to me. This album remains one of the works I’m most proud of, and it’s been a dream to put together this special edition for you. ✨

#Roosevelt #newmusic
